{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CekJdzP7xeb6ocC2DVU8b","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AwGvB1BnUuy2BpWznpi7k7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/qtclustering_claude-fable-5-cc-medium_cuda_r3/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - CUDA Parallel Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - Each outer round evaluates every unclustered point as a candidate seed.\n//    One CUDA thread block grows one candidate cluster (grid-stride over\n//    seeds), so all seeds are evaluated concurrently on the GPU.\n//  - Within a block, threads cooperatively maintain a per-point array holding\n//    the maximum distance from that point to the cluster grown so far. Adding\n//    a member is an O(n) parallel update, and the next member is chosen with\n//    a block-wide argmin reduction that reproduces the sequential\n//    tie-breaking (smallest distance, then lowest point index).\n//  - The host selects the seed with the largest cardinality (earliest seed\n//    wins ties, as in the sequential scan) and a single-block kernel re-grows\n//    that cluster to record its members.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                       \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                        \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);             \\\n            exit(1);                                                           \\\n        }                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic const int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\nstatic const int MAX_GROW_BLOCKS = 512;\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster for `seed` cooperatively with all threads of the\n// calling block. `maxdist[i]` tracks the maximum distance from point i to the\n// cluster members added so far; points that are unavailable (already clustered\n// globally, or already in this cluster) are marked with DBL_MAX. If `members`\n// is non-null the members are recorded in insertion order. Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, const int n,\n                           const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    // Initialize distances to the seed point\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; i < n; i += nt) {\n        if (clustered[i] || i == seed) {\n            maxdist[i] = DBL_MAX;\n        } else {\n            const double dx = pts[i].x - sp.x;\n            const double dy = pts[i].y - sp.y;\n            maxdist[i] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (members && tid == 0) {\n        members[0] = seed;\n    }\n\n    int count = 1;\n    while (count < n) {\n        // Per-thread argmin over its strided slice; ties keep the lowest\n        // index, matching the sequential candidate scan.\n        double best_d = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_i = -1;\n        for (int i = tid; i < n; i += nt) {\n            const double d = maxdist[i];\n            if (d < threshold && (d < best_d || (d == best_d && i < best_i))) {\n                best_d = d;\n                best_i = i;\n            }\n        }\n        sdist[tid] = best_d;\n        sidx[tid] = best_i;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Block-wide argmin reduction\n        for (int s = nt / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < s) {\n                const double od = sdist[tid + s];\n                const int oi = sidx[tid + s];\n                if (oi >= 0 && (sidx[tid] < 0 || od < sdist[tid] ||\n                                (od == sdist[tid] && oi < sidx[tid]))) {\n                    sdist[tid] = od;\n                    sidx[tid] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        const int chosen = sidx[0];\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        if (chosen < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        if (members && tid == 0) {\n            members[count] = chosen;\n        }\n        count++;\n\n        // Fold the new member into the per-point maximum distances\n        const double2 cp = pts[chosen];\n        for (int i = tid; i < n; i += nt) {\n            if (i == chosen) {\n                maxdist[i] = DBL_MAX;\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double d = maxdist[i];\n            if (d != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double dx = pts[i].x - cp.x;\n                const double dy = pts[i].y - cp.y;\n                const double dd = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                if (dd > d) maxdist[i] = dd;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    return count;\n}\n\n// One block per candidate seed (grid-stride): compute the cardinality of the\n// cluster grown from each unclustered seed.\n__global__ void candidateCardinalityKernel(const double2* pts,\n                                           const unsigned char* clustered,\n                                           const int* seeds, const int num_seeds,\n                                           double* workspace, const int n,\n                                           const double threshold,\n                                           int* cardinalities) {\n    double* maxdist = workspace + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * n;\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < num_seeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int card = growCluster(pts, clustered, seeds[s], maxdist, n,\n                                     threshold, nullptr);\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            cardinalities[s] = card;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Single-block kernel: re-grow the winning cluster, recording its members and\n// marking them as clustered on the device.\n__global__ void growBestClusterKernel(const double2* pts,\n                                      unsigned char* clustered, const int seed,\n                                      double* workspace, const int n,\n                                      const double threshold, int* members,\n                                      int* cardinality) {\n    const int card = growCluster(pts, clustered, seed, workspace, n, threshold,\n                                 members);\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        *cardinality = card;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < card; i += blockDim.x) {\n        clustered[members[i]] = 1;\n    }\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    // Device buffers\n    double2* d_points;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered;\n    int* d_seeds;\n    int* d_cardinalities;\n    int* d_members;\n    int* d_best_card;\n    double* d_workspace;\n\n    const int grow_blocks = std::min(N, MAX_GROW_BLOCKS);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_points, N * sizeof(double2)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_clustered, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_seeds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_cardinalities, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_members, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_best_card, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_workspace,\n                          static_cast<size_t>(grow_blocks) * N * sizeof(double)));\n\n    std::vector<double2> h_points(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        h_points[i] = {points[i].x, points[i].y};\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_points, h_points.data(), N * sizeof(double2),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_clustered, 0, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    unclustered_indices.reserve(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> h_cardinalities(N);\n    std::vector<int> h_members(N);\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n\n        // Evaluate every unclustered point as a seed in parallel\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_seeds, unclustered_indices.data(),\n                              num_seeds * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        const int blocks = std::min(num_seeds, grow_blocks);\n        candidateCardinalityKernel<<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(\n            d_points, d_clustered, d_seeds, num_seeds, d_workspace, N,\n            threshold, d_cardinalities);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_cardinalities.data(), d_cardinalities,\n                              num_seeds * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        // Pick the seed with maximum cardinality; the earliest seed in the\n        // unclustered order wins ties, as in the sequential version.\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        for (int s = 0; s < num_seeds; ++s) {\n            if (h_cardinalities[s] > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = h_cardinalities[s];\n                best_seed = unclustered_indices[s];\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) break;\n\n        // Re-grow the winning cluster to obtain its members and mark them\n        // clustered on the device.\n        growBestClusterKernel<<<1, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(d_points, d_clustered,\n                                                 best_seed, d_workspace, N,\n                                                 threshold, d_members,\n                                                 d_best_card);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(h_members.data(), d_members,\n                              max_cardinality * sizeof(int),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        cluster.members.assign(h_members.begin(),\n                               h_members.begin() + max_cardinality);\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        // Mark all members as clustered\n        for (int i = 0; i < max_cardinality; ++i) {\n            clustered[cluster.members[i]] = true;\n        }\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_points));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_clustered));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_seeds));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_cardinalities));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_members));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_best_card));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_workspace));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; If `members`\n// is non-null the members are recorded in insertion order. Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, const int n,\n                           const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    // Initialize distances to the seed point\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; Adding\n//    a member is an O(n) parallel update, and the next member is chosen with\n//    a block-wide argmin reduction that reproduces the sequential\n//    tie-breaking (smallest distance, then lowest point index).\n//  - The host selects the seed with the largest cardinality (earliest seed\n//    wins ties, as in the sequential scan) and a single-block kernel re-grows\n//    that cluster to record its members.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                       \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, int* cand,\n                           const int n, const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sslot[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int num_cand;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) num_cand = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Build the candidate list: unclustered points within threshold of seed\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, int* cand,\n                           const int n, const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sslot[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int num_cand;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) num_cand = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Build the candidate list: unclustered points within threshold of seed\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; Adding\n//    a member is an O(n) parallel update, and the next member is chosen with\n//    a block-wide argmin reduction that reproduces the sequential\n//    tie-breaking (smallest distance, then lowest point index).\n//  - The host selects the seed with the largest cardinality (earliest seed\n//    wins ties, as in the sequential scan) and a single-block kernel re-grows\n//    that cluster to record its members.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                       \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                        \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);             \\\n            exit(1);                                                           \\\n        }                                                                      \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic const int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\nstatic const int MAX_GROW_BLOCKS = 512;\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster for `seed` cooperatively with all threads of the\n// calling block. Only points strictly closer than `threshold` to the seed can\n// ever join (the max-distance to the cluster includes the seed and never\n// shrinks), so those are compacted into a candidate list first. `maxdist[j]`\n// tracks the maximum distance from candidate slot j to the cluster members\n// added so far; slots that become unavailable (added to the cluster, or whose\n// max-distance reached the threshold) are marked with DBL_MAX. If `members`\n// is non-null the members are recorded in insertion order. Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, int* cand,\n                           const int n, const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sslot[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int num_cand;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) num_cand = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Build the candidate list: unclustered points within threshold of seed\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; i < n; i += nt) {\n        if (clustered[i] || i == seed) continue;\n        const double dx = pts[i].x - sp.x;\n        const double dy = pts[i].y - sp.y;\n        const double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        if (d < threshold) {\n            const int slot = atomicAdd(&num_cand, 1);\n            cand[slot] = i;\n            maxdist[slot] = d;\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    const int m = num_cand;\n\n    if (members && tid == 0) {\n        members[0] = seed;\n    }\n\n    int count = 1;\n    while (count <= m) {\n        // Per-thread argmin over its strided slice of candidate slots; Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, int* cand,\n                           const int n, const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sslot[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int num_cand;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) num_cand = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Build the candidate list: unclustered points within threshold of seed\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, int* cand,\n                           const int n, const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sslot[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int num_cand;\n    __shared__ int num_dead;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        num_cand = 0;\n        num_dead = 0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Build the candidate list: unclustered points within threshold of seed.\n    // The `maxdist`/`cand` buffers are 2*n large so the list can be compacted\n    // by ping-ponging between the two halves.\n    double* md_a = maxdist;\n    double* md_b = maxdist + n;\n    int* cand_a = cand;\n    int* cand_b = cand + n;\n\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; Adding\n//    a member is an O(n) parallel update, and the next member is chosen with\n//    a block-wide argmin reduction that reproduces the sequential\n//    tie-breaking (smallest distance, then lowest point index).\n//  - The host selects the seed with the largest cardinality (earliest seed\n//    wins ties, as in the sequential scan) and a single-block kernel re-grows\n//    that cluster to record its members.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                       \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, int* cand,\n                           const int n, const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sslot[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int num_cand;\n    __shared__ int num_dead;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        num_cand = 0;\n        num_dead = 0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Build the candidate list: unclustered points within threshold of seed.\n    // The `maxdist`/`cand` buffers are 2*n large so the list can be compacted\n    // by ping-ponging between the two halves.\n    double* md_a = maxdist;\n    double* md_b = maxdist + n;\n    int* cand_a = cand;\n    int* cand_b = cand + n;\n\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; j < m; j += nt) {\n            if (j == chosen_slot) continue;\n            const double d = md_a[j];\n            if (d != DBL_MAX) {\n                const double dx = pts[cand_a[j]].x - cp.x;\n                const double dy = pts[cand_a[j]].y - cp.y;\n                const double dd = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n                if (dd >= threshold) {\n                    md_a[j] = DBL_MAX;\n                    atomicAdd(&num_dead, 1);\n                } else if (dd > d) {\n                    md_a[j] = dd;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            md_a[chosen_slot] = DBL_MAX;\n            atomicAdd(&num_dead, 1);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Compact the candidate list once at least half its slots are dead.\n        // The list order is arbitrary; Returns the\n// cardinality of the grown cluster.\n__device__ int growCluster(const double2* pts, const unsigned char* clustered,\n                           const int seed, double* maxdist, int* cand,\n                           const int n, const double threshold, int* members) {\n    __shared__ double sdist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sidx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int sslot[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int num_cand;\n    __shared__ int num_dead;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    if (tid == 0) {\n        num_cand = 0;\n        num_dead = 0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Build the candidate list: unclustered points within threshold of seed.\n    // The `maxdist`/`cand` buffers are 2*n large so the list can be compacted\n    // by ping-ponging between the two halves.\n    double* md_a = maxdist;\n    double* md_b = maxdist + n;\n    int* cand_a = cand;\n    int* cand_b = cand + n;\n\n    const double2 sp = pts[seed];\n    for (int i = tid; One thread block grows one candidate cluster, grid-strided over seeds, so all seeds are evaluated concurrently — and the work is split across **all available GPUs** (both RTX 3090s here).\n- **Cooperative cluster growth**: within a block, threads maintain a per-candidate \"max distance to the cluster so far\" array. Adding a member is an O(candidates) parallel update instead of recomputing distances to all members, and the next member is picked with a block-wide argmin reduction that reproduces the sequential tie-breaking exactly (smallest distance, then lowest point index — which is why hashes match bit-for-bit).\n- **Threshold pruning + compaction**: only points strictly within `threshold` of the seed can ever join (the max-distance includes the seed and never shrinks), so each block compacts to that small candidate set up front, prunes candidates whose max-distance crosses the threshold, and re-compacts the list whenever half its slots are dead.\n- **Dirty-seed caching across rounds**: a seed's grown cluster depends only on the availability of points within `threshold` of it, so cardinalities are cached and a small GPU kernel re-marks only seeds near the just-removed cluster for re-evaluation. This turns most rounds into near-no-ops.\n- The winning cluster is re-grown once by a single-block kernel to record its members.
